layout_sources: https://github.com/firefly-iii/import-configurations/blob/main/cz/postovnisporitelna/default.json (Poštovní spořitelna, a ČSOB brand on the ČSOB platform: semicolon, header row, d.m.Y, 15 columns: account, booking date, amount, currency, balance, counter-account number, its bank code, its name, five ignored (KS, VS, SS, operation, transaction id), the note, and a trailing empty field)
Column words (lower-case, "číslo účtu;datum zaúčtování;částka;měna;zůstatek;...") from memory of ČSOB Internetbanking exports.
notes: ČSOB internet banking transaction history as CSV. Windows-1250, CRLF, semicolon-separated, unquoted, every line ending in ;. Lower-case column names; dates DD.MM.YYYY; částka signed with a comma decimal (no thousands mark assumed); měna CZK; zůstatek is the balance after each line. Newest first (assumed). Closing = the newest zůstatek; opening = the oldest zůstatek minus its amount. The newer ČSOB internet bank may export a different layout; not confirmed.
